DomainData.MainInfoText: Ha u etela sebaka sefe kapa sefe sa Marang-rang, se ka boloka kapa sa fumana lintlha ho sebatli sa hau, hangata e le li-cookies. Litaba tsena e kanna ea ba ka uena, likhetho tsa hau kapa sesebelisoa sa hau, 'me hangata li sebelisoa ho etsa hore sebaka sa marang-rang se sebetse kamoo o se lebelletseng. Litaba hangata ha li u khetholle ka kotloloho, empa li ka u fa boiphihlelo ba tepo bo ikhethileng haholoanyane. Hobane re hlompha tokelo ea hau ea lekunutu, u ka khetha ho se lumelle mefuta e meng ea li-cookies. Tobetsa lihloohong tse fapaneng tsa lihlopha ho tseba haholoanyane le ho fetola litlhophiso tsa rona tsa kamehla. Leha ho le joalo, ho thibela mefuta e meng ea li-cookies ho ka ama boiphihlelo ba hau ba sebaka sa marang-rang le lits'ebeletso tseo re khonang ho fana ka tsona.

DomainData.CookieListDescription: Kuku ke karolo e nyane ea data (faele ea mongolo) eo sebaka sa Marang-rang - ha se eteloa ke mosebelisi - se kopang sebatli sa hau ho se boloka sesebelisoa sa hau ho hopola lintlha ka uena, joalo ka khetho ea puo ea hau kapa tlhaiso-leseling ea ho kena. Li-cookie tseo li behiloe ke rona 'me li bitsoa li-cookie tsa motho oa pele. Re boetse re sebelisa li-cookies tsa batho ba bang - e leng li-cookies tse tsoang sebakeng se fapaneng le sebaka sa sebaka sa marang-rang seo u se etetseng - molemong oa lipapatso tsa rona le boiteko ba rona ba ho bapatsa. Haholo-holo, re sebelisa li-cookies le mahlale a mang a ho latedisa merero e latelang:

Groups.GroupDescription: Li-cookie tsena lia hlokahala hore sebaka sa marang-rang se sebetse 'me ha se khone ho tima lits'ebetsong tsa rona. Hangata li behiloe feela ho latela liketso tse entsoeng ke uena tse lekanang le kopo ea litšebeletso, tse kang ho beha likhetho tsa hau tsa boinotši, ho kena kapa ho tlatsa liforomo. U ka etsa hore sebatli sa hau se u thibele kapa se u hlokomelise ka li-cookies tsena, empa likarolo tse ling tsa sebaka sa marang-rang li ke ke tsa sebetsa. Li-cookie tsena ha li boloke tlhahisoleseling efe kapa efe eo motho a ka u tsebang.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: AWSALB
FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie name is associated with the Amazon Web Services Elastic Load Balancing functionality for routing client request on the server.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: OptanonConsent
FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie is set by the cookie compliance solution from OneTrust. It stores information about the categories of cookies the site uses and whether visitors have given or withdrawn consent for the use of each category. This enables site owners to prevent cookies in each category from being set in the users browser, when consent is not given. The cookie has a normal lifespan of one year, so that returning visitors to the site will have their preferences remembered. It contains no information that can identify the site visitor.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: AWSALBCORS
FirstPartyCookies.description: This AWS cookie is used for load balancing.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: OptanonAlertBoxClosed
FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie is set by websites using certain versions of the cookie law compliance solution from OneTrust.  It is set after visitors have seen a cookie information notice and in some cases only when they actively close the notice down.  It enables the website not to show the message more than once to a user.  The cookie has a one year lifespan and contains no personal information.

Groups.GroupDescription: Li-cookie tsena li re lumella ho bala maeto le mehloli ea sephethephethe e le hore re tsebe ho lekanya le ho ntlafatsa ts'ebetso ea sebaka sa rona sa marang-rang. Li re thusa ho tseba hore na ke maqephe afe a tsebahalang haholo le a sa tumang le ho bona kamoo baeti ba tsamaeang ho potoloha sebaka seo. Lintlha tsohle tse bokelletsoeng ke li-cookie tsena li kopantsoe, kahoo ha li tsejoe. Haeba u sa lumelle li-cookie tsena, re ke ke ra tseba ha u etetse sebaka sa rona sa marang-rang, 'me re ke ke ra khona ho beha leihlo tšebetso ea sona.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: _gat
FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie name is associated with Google Universal Analytics, according to documentation it is used to throttle the request rate - limiting the collection of data on high traffic sites. It expires after 10 minutes.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: _ga
FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie name is associated with Google Universal Analytics - which is a significant update to Google's more commonly used analytics service. This cookie is used to distinguish unique users by assigning a randomly generated number as a client identifier. It is included in each page request in a site and used to calculate visitor, session and campaign data for the sites analytics reports.  By default it is set to expire after 2 years, although this is customisable by website owners.
